ledger_note: This is a complete packet-level ledger. The first thirteen rationales are retrospective reconstructions from the frozen source, final translation, recorded consultations, and deterministic QA; the responsive-figure decision was recorded contemporaneously during the current repair. None is represented as human-expert intent. Provisional terminology is usable and is not a release hold.
